import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input data
input_file = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify numeric indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
id_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_cols]

# Median imputation for missing values in indicator columns
imputed_data = df[indicator_cols].fillna(df[indicator_cols].median())

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(imputed_data)

# KMeans clustering with k=3, random_state=0, n_init=10
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_data)

# Create city clusters output
df_clusters = df.copy()
df_clusters['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels
df_clusters_output = df_clusters[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'cluster_id']]
df_clusters_output.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False)

# Create cluster profiles output (mean of each indicator per cluster)
profiles_data = []
for cluster_id in range(3):
    mask = cluster_labels == cluster_id
    cluster_mean = imputed_data[mask].mean()
    row = {'cluster_id': cluster_id}
    row.update(cluster_mean.to_dict())
    profiles_data.append(row)

df_profiles = pd.DataFrame(profiles_data)
df_profiles = df_profiles[['cluster_id'] + indicator_cols]
df_profiles.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False)
</solution_file>
